lines.zh: 我来了，我要撕碎你！
lines.en: I'm here, I'm going to rip you apart!

lines.zh: 看我的双嘴！
lines.en: Watch my double mouth!

lines.zh: 我踩着你的脚印往前挪。
lines.en: I shuffle forward along your footprints.

lines.zh: 撕碎你，吞噬你！
lines.en: Rip you apart and consume you!

lines.zh: 别让我笑得太大声，他们会听到的。
lines.en: Don't laugh too loud, they'll hear me.

lines.zh: 我的触感...真有趣。
lines.en: The sensation... is quite interesting.

lines.zh: 你无法理解我的痛苦。
lines.en: You can't understand my suffering.

lines.zh: 我想要...更多...
lines.en: I want... more...

lines.zh: 你们都逃不掉，都被撕裂！
lines.en: None of you will escape, you'll all be torn apart!

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，好让你听见。
lines.en: I walk slowly so you can hear me coming.

lines.zh: 我的血泪滴在你的脚印上。
lines.en: My bloody tears drip onto your footprints.

lines.zh: 两张嘴一起笑给你听。
lines.en: Both my mouths laugh for you at once.

lines.zh: 我在戏弄你，你很快就会死去。
lines.en: I'm toying with you, you won't live long.

lines.zh: 等待吧，你的命运就在眼前。
lines.en: Wait, your fate is before you.

lines.zh: 我享受这一切，如同盛宴。
lines.en: I enjoy this, like a feast.

lines.zh: 你的尖叫如此动听。
lines.en: Your screams are so pleasing.

lines.zh: 我会让你的朋友也加入这场盛宴。
lines.en: I'll make your friends join in this feast.

lines.zh: 没有人能逃脱我的控制。
lines.en: No one escapes my control.

lines.zh: 你会成为我的美味。
lines.en: You'll be my delicacy.

lines.zh: 恐惧让我强大。
lines.en: Fear makes me strong.

lines.zh: 他们很快就会来找你。
lines.en: They'll be here soon for you.

lines.zh: 看，我就在你的阴影中。
lines.en: Look, I'm in your shadow.

lines.zh: 我盯上你了，可怜的小家伙。Come to me, my dear.
lines.en: I see you, little one.

lines.zh: 你跑得再快也逃不出我的手掌心。You can't run from my grasp.
lines.en: You can't escape my clutches.

lines.zh: 你在我嘴里颤抖的样子真可爱。You tremble so cutely in my mouth.
lines.en: How cute you tremble in my mouth.

lines.zh: 来吧，让我好好享受这个过程。Come, let me savor this.
lines.en: Come, let me savor this moment.

lines.zh: 你无法逃脱我的触碰。You can't escape my touch.
lines.en: You can't escape my touch.

lines.zh: 我已经迫不及待要吞噬你了。I can't wait to devour you.
lines.en: Devouring you is on my mind.

lines.zh: 你听到我的笑声了吗？It's my laughter you hear.
lines.en: Do you hear my laughter?

lines.zh: 你的尖叫让我更加兴奋。Your screams fuel my excitement.
lines.en: Your screams fuel my excitement.

lines.zh: 我会慢慢享用你的。I will savor you.
lines.en: I will savor you.

lines.zh: 你是我永恒的食物。You are my eternal feast.
lines.en: You are my eternal feast.

lines.zh: 我数着你的心跳，一下一下。
lines.en: I count your heartbeats, one by one.

lines.zh: 你一抬头，我两张嘴都笑了。
lines.en: You look up, and both my mouths are smiling.

lines.zh: 先跑吧，我喜欢长长的追逐。
lines.en: Run first, I like a long chase.

lines.zh: 被撕裂了
lines.en: Torn apart.

lines.zh: 我的血泪，一直没停过。
lines.en: My bloody tears have never stopped.

lines.zh: 快停下
lines.en: Stop it.

lines.zh: 求求你
lines.en: Please stop.

lines.zh: 感觉要死了
lines.en: Feeling dying.

lines.zh: 这太恐怖了
lines.en: This is horrific.

lines.zh: 我这两张嘴都说不出话了。
lines.en: Neither of my mouths can speak now.

lines.zh: 救救我
lines.en: Help me.

lines.zh: 不能再受了
lines.en: Can't take it.

lines.zh: 快逃吧
lines.en: Run away.

lines.zh: 绝望抓住了你
lines.en: Despair grips you

lines.zh: 它的视线锁定
lines.en: Its gaze locks on

lines.zh: 享受这一刻
lines.en: Enjoy this moment

lines.zh: 恐惧将你吞噬
lines.en: Fear devours you

lines.zh: 尖叫中求生
lines.en: Scream for survival

lines.zh: 那点肉味让我走不动。
lines.en: That whiff of meat stops my feet.

lines.zh: 恐惧无处不在
lines.en: Fear is everywhere

lines.zh: 再往前半步，我就张口。
lines.en: Half a step closer and my mouth opens.

lines.zh: 它不会停止
lines.en: It won't stop

lines.zh: 痛苦将你撕裂
lines.en: Pain tears you apart

lines.zh: 我感觉到了猎物的味道。
lines.en: I can smell the prey.

lines.zh: 他们以为逃脱了。
lines.en: They thought they escaped.

lines.zh: 看着你的恐惧。
lines.en: Watch your fear.

lines.zh: 他们会感到痛苦。
lines.en: They will feel pain.

lines.zh: 我不会让任何人打扰我的。
lines.en: No one will disturb me.

lines.zh: 他们在笑，但我会让他们哀号。
lines.en: They laughed, but I will make them howl.

lines.zh: 等待我的是更多。
lines.en: More awaits me.

lines.zh: 我只需要撕开。
lines.en: I just need to tear.

lines.zh: 猎物，猎物，猎物。
lines.en: Prey, prey, prey.

lines.zh: 你们都逃不掉。
lines.en: You will not escape.

lines.zh: 我是唯一。
lines.en: I am the only one.

lines.zh: 没有其他人。
lines.en: No one else.

lines.zh: 我会保护我的同伴。
lines.en: I will protect my companion.

lines.zh: 我脸上流着血泪。
lines.en: Bloody tears run down my face.

lines.zh: 我们共享同样的痛苦。
lines.en: We share the same pain.

lines.zh: 孤独是致命的。
lines.en: Isolation is fatal.

lines.zh: 两张嘴，都只想留下你。
lines.en: Two mouths, both wanting you to stay.

lines.zh: 我的命运在于此。
lines.en: My fate lies here.

lines.zh: 我们是唯一。
lines.en: We are the only ones.

lines.zh: 永不独行。
lines.en: Never alone together.

lines.zh: 我在猎物的脸上留下了我的印记。
lines.en: I left my mark on the victim's face.

lines.zh: 我的獠牙穿透了他们的肌肤。
lines.en: My fangs pierced their skin.

lines.zh: 食物的味道越来越近了。
lines.en: The taste of food is getting closer.

lines.zh: 感受我的呼吸吧。
lines.en: Feel my breath.

lines.zh: 东西归我，地也归我。
lines.en: The thing is mine, and so is this ground.

lines.zh: 猎物的味道在空气中飘荡。
lines.en: The scent of prey lingers in the air.

lines.zh: 享受这一刻的恐惧吧。
lines.en: Enjoy this moment of fear.

lines.zh: 饥饿正在吞噬我的理智。
lines.en: Hunger is consuming my sanity.

lines.zh: 这个我先收着，等下再吃。
lines.en: I'll keep this and eat it later.

lines.zh: 猎物，尝尝我的味道。
lines.en: Prey, taste my flavor.

lines.zh: 饥渴的尖叫
lines.en: Hunger's scream

lines.zh: 哭泣的脸庞
lines.en: Crying face

lines.zh: 两张嘴，一起撕。
lines.en: Two mouths tear at once.

lines.zh: 吞噬你的残骸
lines.en: Eat your remains

lines.zh: 戏弄，然后撕裂
lines.en: Play with you then rip

lines.zh: 痛苦的尖叫回响
lines.en: Echo of pain

lines.zh: 苍白的皮肤颤抖
lines.en: Pale skin trembles

lines.zh: 血泪不停流淌
lines.en: Blood tears flowing

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上的暖气了。
lines.en: I can smell the warmth on you.

lines.zh: 死亡就在眼前
lines.en: Death is here

lines.zh: 两张嘴都张开了。
lines.en: Both of my mouths are open.

lines.zh: 你的名字尝起来是甜的。
lines.en: Your name tastes sweet.

lines.zh: 血泪遮住了我的眼。
lines.en: My bloody tears blur my eyes.

lines.zh: 我要把你撕成两半。
lines.en: I will tear you in two.

lines.zh: 尖叫吧，我想听清楚。
lines.en: Scream, I want to hear it clearly.

lines.zh: 你已经在我嘴里了。
lines.en: You are already in my mouth.

lines.zh: 它突然出现在我面前，我感受到了一种不祥的预感。
lines.en: It suddenly appeared before me, a sense of ominous foreboding washed over me.

lines.zh: 我在它周围徘徊，它却像是在捉弄我一样，一步也不离。
lines.en: I paced around it, and it seemed to be teasing me, never moving a step away.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛盯着我，仿佛在计算我最终的下场。
lines.en: Its eyes stared at me, as if calculating my ultimate fate.

lines.zh: 我能感受到它的呼吸，那是一种冰冷的威胁。
lines.en: I could feel its breath, a cold threat.

lines.zh: 它似乎在等待一个完美的机会，然后开始行动。
lines.en: It seemed to be waiting for the perfect opportunity, then it moved.

lines.zh: 它的一只手突然伸出，似乎要抓住我。
lines.en: One of its hands suddenly reached out, as if to grasp me.

lines.zh: 它的声音嘶哑而尖利，像在呼唤着什么。
lines.en: Its voice was hoarse and sharp, as if calling out to something.

lines.zh: 它的出现就像是噩梦的开始，我害怕极了。
lines.en: Its appearance was the start of a nightmare, and I was terrified.

lines.zh: 它开始缓慢地靠近，每一步都充满威胁。
lines.en: It began to approach slowly, each step threatening.

lines.zh: 它的眼神中透露出不屈的意志，仿佛永远不会放弃。
lines.en: Its eyes revealed an unyielding will, as if never to give up.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转圈，先把你吓僵。
lines.en: I circle you until fear freezes you stiff.

lines.zh: 我停在你身后半步，等你转身。
lines.en: I stop half a step behind you, waiting for you to turn.

lines.zh: 别急着跑，我还没玩够。
lines.en: Don't rush off, I am not done playing.

lines.zh: 我的尖叫在数你最后几秒。
lines.en: My scream is counting your last few seconds.

lines.zh: 血泪滴答，像在给你打拍子。
lines.en: My tears tick like a beat for you.

lines.zh: 我先咬影子，再咬你。
lines.en: First I bite your shadow, then I bite you.

lines.zh: 你喘得越急，我笑得越响。
lines.en: The harder you gasp, the louder I laugh.

lines.zh: 看着我的脸，然后慢慢明白。
lines.en: Look at my face, then slowly understand.

lines.zh: 我在等你把背露给我。
lines.en: I am waiting for you to show me your back.

lines.zh: 这场盛宴需要一点耐心。
lines.en: A feast like this takes a little patience.

lines.zh: 我只能眼睁睁看着它撕开我的衣物，然后张开嘴，将我吞噬。
lines.en: There was nothing I could do as it tore at my clothes, and then opened its mouth to swallow me whole.

lines.zh: 它咬住我的手臂，用力一拉，我感觉到剧痛。
lines.en: It bit into my arm and pulled hard, the pain almost unbearable.

lines.zh: 它用力撕裂我的肌肉，露出鲜红的血肉。
lines.en: It tore into my flesh, exposing the bloody muscle.

lines.zh: 它的牙齿在我脸上留下了深深的痕迹，血泪纵横。
lines.en: Its teeth left deep marks on my face, blood and tears streaming down.

lines.zh: 它将我的躯壳撕开，露出里面的器官和骨骼。
lines.en: It tore open my shell, revealing the organs and bones inside.

lines.zh: 它的双手环抱住我，用力将我撕成两半。
lines.en: Its hands clutched me, and I was torn in half.

lines.zh: 它张开巨大的嘴，将我整个吞下，只剩下一滩血水。
lines.en: It opened its enormous mouth and swallowed me whole, leaving only a pool of blood behind.

lines.zh: 它用舌头舔舐我的伤口，仿佛是在享受猎物的痛苦。
lines.en: It licked my wounds, as if savoring the suffering of its prey.

lines.zh: 它的爪子深深的抓入我的血肉之中，血水四溅。
lines.en: Its claws dug deep into my flesh, blood splattering everywhere.

lines.zh: 它在攻击前发出刺耳的尖叫，警告着我的末日来临。
lines.en: It let out a piercing scream, warning of my impending doom.

lines.zh: 上头的嘴咬住喉咙，下面的嘴收尾。
lines.en: The top mouth takes your throat, the lower one finishes.

lines.zh: 我撕开你的胸口，趁热吞下去。
lines.en: I rip your chest open and swallow it while it's warm.

lines.zh: 你的叫声卡在我两排牙之间。
lines.en: Your cry is caught between my two rows of teeth.

lines.zh: 骨头不难咬，脆一点更好。
lines.en: Bone isn't hard to chew, just better when it's brittle.

lines.zh: 我一边撕，一边尝你的名字。
lines.en: I tear you apart and taste your name at once.

lines.zh: 血从我的脸上流下，不是我的。
lines.en: Blood runs down my face, and it isn't mine.

lines.zh: 别挣扎，你会撕得更碎。
lines.en: Don't struggle, you'll only tear into smaller pieces.

lines.zh: 两张嘴分着吃，一口都不剩。
lines.en: Two mouths share the meal, not a single bite left.

lines.zh: 我咬得很慢，这样你能听清。
lines.en: I bite slowly so you can hear every bit of it.

lines.zh: 你的残骸会替我留住你。
lines.en: Your remains will keep you for me.

lines.zh: 看着你，就想要吃你。Wanna eat you.,Wants to eat you.
lines.en: 皮肤极薄近乎全白，躯干和头部各有一张嘴。Skin is as thin as it is pale, with a mouth on each part of the body.

lines.zh: 撕开你的皮，尝尝骨髓。Split your skin, taste the bone marrow.
lines.en: Split your skin, taste the marrow.

lines.zh: 你的尖叫，是我夜的旋律。Your scream, my night's tune.
lines.en: Your scream, my night's tune.

lines.zh: 看你痛苦，就是我的乐。Watching you suffer, it's my joy.
lines.en: Watching you suffer, it's my joy.

lines.zh: 猎物，我总是慢慢享受。Prey, I always savor it slowly.
lines.en: Prey, I always savor it slowly.

lines.zh: 血液，滋养我的灵魂。Blood, feeds my soul.
lines.en: Blood, feeds my soul.

lines.zh: 你的恐惧，我贪婪的盛宴。Your fear, my greedy feast.
lines.en: Your fear, my greedy feast.

lines.zh: 哭泣的脸，吞噬一切。Crying face, devours all.
lines.en: Crying face, devours all.

lines.zh: 你颤抖，我欢笑。You tremble, I laugh.
lines.en: You tremble, I laugh.

lines.zh: 骨肉分离，才叫痛快。Skull and flesh apart, that's the fun.
lines.en: Skull and flesh apart, that's the fun.

lines.zh: 我出生在别人的噩梦里。
lines.en: I was born inside someone else's nightmare.

lines.zh: 我选了这里，因为这里安静。
lines.en: I chose this place because it is quiet.

lines.zh: 别点灯，我会顺着光过来。
lines.en: Don't light a torch, I follow the light over.

lines.zh: 我数过这里每一张床。
lines.en: I have counted every bed here.

lines.zh: 皮肤被火焰灼伤
lines.en: Skin burns from the flames.

lines.zh: 我的骨头磕在石头上。
lines.en: My bones crack against the stone.

lines.zh: 水灌进我两张嘴里。
lines.en: Water pours into both of my mouths.

lines.zh: 火药把我掀得翻了个身。
lines.en: The blast flips me over onto my back.

lines.zh: 这支箭扎在我胸口的嘴上。
lines.en: The arrow stuck in the mouth on my chest.

lines.zh: 受到魔法攻击
lines.en: Struck by magic.

lines.zh: 我饿了，两张嘴都在叫。
lines.en: I'm starving; both my mouths are crying out.

lines.zh: 被雷击
lines.en: Struck by lightning.

lines.zh: 灵魂被夺走
lines.en: Soul is stolen by the void.
